Eura Drives America LLC specializes in variable frequency drives (VFDs) and servo solutions for a wide range of industrial applications. The company focuses on delivering reliable motion control and automation products that support customers in improving efficiency, performance, and energy savings. With a commitment to engineering excellence, Eura Drives America LLC emphasizes quality, innovation, and responsive technical support. Team members collaborate in an environment that values continuous learning and practical problem\-solving for real\-world industrial challenges.
 


**Role Description** 

 This remote role is for a
 **VFD and Servo Design Engineer (Hardware/Software)** 
 responsible for the development and optimization of motion control products. Day‑to‑day tasks include designing and refining hardware circuits and embedded software for VFD and servo drives, performing simulations, and selecting components to meet performance, safety, and reliability requirements.
 



 The role involves creating and reviewing schematics, PCB layouts, and firmware, as well as testing prototypes, analyzing test results, and implementing design improvements. The engineer will collaborate with cross\-functional teams on product specifications, documentation, and design reviews, and will support manufacturing, quality, and field teams with technical guidance and troubleshooting. The position also includes staying current with industry standards and emerging technologies to inform new product features and enhancements.
 


**Responsibilities** 
* Develop, tune, and optimize
 **motion control algorithms** 
 , including position, velocity, and torque loops for servo and synchronous motors.
* Implement and refine
 **field‑oriented control (FOC)** 
 , vector control, and advanced motor‑control strategies.
* Design and validate
 **trajectory planning** 
 , interpolation, and multi‑axis synchronization functions.
* Conduct system‑level modeling and simulation of motor‑drive‑load dynamics using tools such as MATLAB/Simulink or similar platforms.
* Perform
 **motor parameter identification** 
 , auto‑tuning routines, and closed‑loop stability analysis.
* Integrate motion control features with industrial communication protocols (e.g., EtherCAT CiA402, CANopen DS402\).
* Support application engineers and customers with
 **servo tuning** 
 , motion profile optimization, and system‑level troubleshooting.
* Validate motion performance through lab testing, including inertia matching, load disturbance response, and precision positioning accuracy.


**Qualifications** 
* Strong design engineering skills, with experience in motion control or power electronics design for VFDs, servo drives, or related products.
* Mechanical engineering and product design skills to support enclosure design, thermal management, and integration into customer systems.
* Electrical engineering expertise, including analog and digital circuit design, power electronics, motor control principles, and safety standards.
* Proficiency with computer\-aided design (CAD) tools for schematics, PCB layout, and mechanical modeling.
* Relevant experience with embedded software or firmware for motor control (e.g., C/C\+\+, microcontrollers, DSPs), including debugging and optimization.
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Ability to work independently in a remote setting, manage multiple projects, and communicate clearly with distributed teams.
* Familiarity with industrial communication protocols (such as Modbus, CAN, EtherCAT, or Ethernet\-based fieldbuses) and applicable safety/EMC standards is a plus.


**Requirements** 
* Hands‑on experience with
 **servo motor control** 
 , including PMSM, BLDC, and stepper systems.
* Strong understanding of
 **control theory** 
 , including PID tuning, feedforward control, and stability analysis.
* Experience implementing
 **real‑time control algorithms** 
 on DSPs, FPGAs, or ARM‑based microcontrollers.
* Knowledge of
 **multi‑axis motion systems** 
 , robotics, CNC, or automation machinery is highly desirable.
* Familiarity with
 **position feedback devices** 
 such as incremental/absolute encoders, resolvers, and serial feedback protocols (e.g., BiSS‑C, EnDat, Hiperface).
* Experience with
 **motion profile generation** 
 (S‑curve, trapezoidal, jerk‑limited profiles).
* Ability to analyze motor performance data, including torque ripple, cogging, bandwidth, and dynamic response.

**Description**
 Annapurna Labs designs silicon and software that accelerates innovation. Our custom chips, accelerators, and software stacks enable us to tackle unprecedented technical challenges and deliver solutions that help customers change the world. AWS Neuron is the complete software stack powering AWS Trainium (Trn2/Trn3\), our cloud scale Machine Learning accelerators and we are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our ML Distributed Training team.
   

  

 In this role, you will be responsible for the development, enablement, and performance optimization of large scale ML model training across diverse model families. This includes massive scale pre\-training and post\-training of LLMs with Dense and Mixture\-of\-Experts architectures, Multimodal models that are transformer and diffusion based, and Reinforcement Learning workloads. You will work at the intersection of ML research and high performance systems, collaborating closely with chip architects, compiler engineers, runtime engineers and AWS solution architects to deliver cost\-effective, performant machine learning solutions on AWS Trainium based systems.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 You will contribute to the design and implementation of distributed training solutions for large\-scale ML models running on Trainium instances. A significant part of your work will involve extending and optimizing popular distributed training frameworks including FSDP, torchtitan, and Hugging Face libraries for the Neuron ecosystem.
   

  

 A core focus of this role involves developing and optimizing mixed\-precision and low\-precision training techniques. You will work with BF16, FP8, and emerging numerical formats to improve training throughput while maintaining model accuracy and convergence quality. This includes implementing precision\-aware training strategies, loss scaling techniques, and careful gradient management to ensure training stability across reduced precision formats.
   

  

 Beyond precision optimization, you will profile, analyze, and tune end\-to\-end training pipelines to achieve optimal performance on Trainium hardware. You will partner with hardware, compiler, and runtime teams to understand system constraints and unlock new capabilities. Additionally, you will collaborate with AWS solution architects and customers to support the deployment and optimization of training workloads at scale.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Annapurna Labs was a startup company acquired by AWS in 2015, and is now fully integrated. If AWS is an infrastructure company, then think Annapurna Labs as the infrastructure provider of AWS. Our org covers multiple disciplines including silicon engineering, hardware design and verification, software, and operations. AWS Nitro, ENA, EFA, Graviton and F1 EC2 Instances, AWS Neuron, Inferentia and Trainium ML Accelerators, and in storage with scalable NVMe, are some of the products we have delivered, over the last few years.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, computer engineering, or related field, or Bachelor's degree
* 1\+ years of programming experience with at least one software programming language (including academic projects, internships, or research)
* Experience with software development practices including code reviews, source control, testing, and build processes
* Experience with machine learning concepts and at least one ML framework (PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow)


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree or above in computer science or equivalent
* Experience with large\-scale distributed training or LLM workloads
* Experience with computer architecture or hardware\-software co\-optimization
* Experience with distributed systems, libraries, or frameworks
* Familiarity with end\-to\-end model training pipelines
* Previous internship or research experience in ML infrastructure or systems software
